purpose: Four-frame local pixel-art ambient visitors for the battle arena
processing: Connected-alpha silhouette extraction, proportional nearest-neighbor resize, manual registration point per pose; no runtime atlas slicing.

jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: four-frame ambient animation for a classic SNES dark-fantasy RPG battlefield. Create ONE WIDE 3:1 strip with FOUR distinct sequential motion poses of the SAME subject, all facing RIGHT, arranged horizontally. Detailed polished 16-bit pixel art, crisp readable pixel clusters, natural anatomy, restrained rich shading, matching the pixel art reference. No text or panel borders. Each pose fully separate with at least 70px genuinely transparent empty gutter. Complete silhouettes and outer margins: no clipped wings, antlers, wheels or feet. Genuinely transparent alpha background, no white paper, gray haze, backdrop, floor, shadow or scenery. Keep head and torso at the SAME height and scale across frames; only articulated parts move, seamless looping motion. Subject: ONE handsome black raven flying horizontally, glossy charcoal and subtle blue-violet feather highlights, black beak, no equipment. Four wingbeat phases: wings high, wings halfway down, wings low, wings halfway rising. Side/three-quarter view. Bird body axis remains horizontal, legs tucked. No other bird in a pose.
